Reports are sanitized: versions, the failed step and a short technical trace, without raw messages, full crash logs, URLs, local paths, credentials, coordinates, seeds, world, player or server names, or capture contents. The mod keeps at most eight pending reports, for at most seven days. Turning diagnostics off or changing account or API purges this queue; turning them off also asks the server to delete this device's reports, and if it cannot be reached, its retention applies. Turn them off in M → Settings → Privacy → Diagnostics.
